column1: # Known bugs of specific upstream versions, for candidate builds
# A released pin has no entry here: a pin's incompatibilities are in
# selftest-known.tsv. An entry names an upstream version that is built as a
# candidate, so that one upstream bug is reported as such instead of hiding
#   2  upstream version, as print-capabilities reports it (.upstream.version)
#   5  self-test case (scripts/selftest.sh CASES), or * for any
# The adapter must be the client or the server of the pairing, at that
# version. A matching case that fails is recorded "known" and does not fail
# the self-test; one that passes is recorded "pass" with a note to remove the
# entry: the bug is fixed and the pin can move.
